item.title: Apache Nutch v1.5.1 Released
item.description: The Apache Nutch PMC are very pleased to announce the release of Apache Nutch v1.5.1. This release is a maintainence release of the popular 1.5.X mainstream version of Nutch which has been widely adopted within the community. Please see the list of changes made in this version for a full breakdown. The release is available here.
